	# Developer note: assume that Header_Mapping is correct here. Advanced

	import json
	
	columns = ["cve", "etc"]
	res = [{col: "" for col in columns}]
	
	header_mapping = None # {"Item": "Header Row#", "Value": 1}, {"Item": "Sheet Name", "Value": "Sheet1"}, {"Item": "CVE Column", "Value": "CVE"}, {"Item": "Likelihood Column", "Value": "Likelihood"}, {"Item": "Scan_Source_UID Column", "Value": "Scan_Source_UID"}, {"Item": "Solution Column", "Value": "Solution"}, {"Item": "Title Column", "Value": "Title"}
	table = None
	try:
	  header_mapping = json.loads(Header_Mapping)
	  header_mapping[0]["Value"] = int(header_mapping[0]["Value"])
	
	  sheets = json.loads(context['document_text'])
	  for sheet in sheets:
	    if header_mapping[1]["Value"] == sheet["name"]:
	      table = sheet["table"]
	      break
	
	  if not table:
	    return res
	except:
	  return res
	
	header = table[header_mapping[0]["Value"] - 1]
	table = table[header_mapping[0]["Value"]:]
	cve_idx = header.index(header_mapping[2]["Value"])
	likelihood_idx = header.index(header_mapping[3]["Value"])
	ss_uuid_idx = header.index(header_mapping[4]["Value"])
	solution_idx = header.index(header_mapping[5]["Value"])
	title_idx = header.index(header_mapping[6]["Value"])
	
	res[0] = {col: "all others for {col}" for col in columns}
	
	return res
